mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post ( member_id, content, file_url, subscriber_only ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{content}, #{fileUrl}, #{subscriberOnly} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.member_id, p.content, p.file_url, p.like_count, p.subscriber_only, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM post p WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM block b WHERE (b.member_id = #{memberId} AND b.blocked_id = p.member_id) OR (b.member_id = p.member_id AND b.blocked_id = #{memberId}) )

SELECT p.id AS id, m.id AS member_id, m.name, m.unique_id, m.profile_image, p.content, p.file_url, p.like_count, p.subscriber_only, p.created_at AS created_at, p.updated_at AS updated_at FROM post p JOIN member m ON p.member_id = m.id WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM block b WHERE (b.member_id = #{memberId} AND b.blocked_id = p.member_id) OR (b.member_id = p.member_id AND b.blocked_id = #{memberId}) )
